title: Verbs That Change Meaning in the Past
goal: Use conocer, saber, querer and poder in the preterite to say that you met, found out, tried, refused or managed.
grammar: Verbs that change meaning in the past

items: I can use conocí, supe, quise and pude for meeting, finding out, trying and managing.
I can say that someone refused to do something with no quiso.
I can use the new words for choices and results.
